description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Probes carry sender_hw = DUT interface MAC (RFC 3927 §2.1.1, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The Probe's ARP sender_hw field is what conflict detectors on the segment use to identify the prober. RFC 3927 §2.1.1 requires it to equal the prober's own hardware address — i.e. the DUT's outgoing interface MAC. Anything else makes the Probe useless for collision detection.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Probe (the first one)
     - ARP sender_hw == DUT's own iface MAC   ← key check

[Pass condition]
First DUT Probe's ARP sender_hw equals the DUT's interface MAC.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_sender_hw_not_dut_iface_mac — sender_hw differs from the DUT's outgoing iface MAC
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted Probe carries DUT iface MAC as sender_hw — normal
verdicts.Fail_sender_hw_not_dut_iface_mac: Probe sender_hw is not the DUT's interface MAC
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
